title: HubSpot Bearer header placeholders and public identifiers
summary: Bare Bearer prose, a scheme-only header, placeholders, references, masked values, and public account, client and scope identifiers.
rationale: The word Bearer names a scheme and is also an everyday term, so prose or a header with no value is not a credential, and a placeholder, reference or masked display carries no value. A hub or account id, a client id and scope names are public identifiers that sit next to tokens in the same requests.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no credential value. That a placeholder, reference or public identifier is not a value is a project decision, not a HubSpot statement.

sources.supports: This token is provided as a Bearer token in the request, and expires after 30 minutes.
